description: Delete a SimplifyQA release (Releases → Delete). TWO-STEP: call with `releaseId` (id, code like RE-45, or exact name) and no `confirm` to PREVIEW — it lists everything still linked (its sprints, stories, defects, tasks, execution plans, pipelines, schedules, other projects using it) and deletes nothing. Show that to the user, and call again with `confirm:true` ONLY after the user explicitly says to delete. A release that anything still uses is refused even with confirm. Only an admin user can delete a release.

confirm.description: true on the SECOND call, only after the user explicitly said to delete.

releaseId.description: Release id, code (RE-45) or exact name.
